'''2011 Worlds Day 2 David Destefanis LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[David Destefanis]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck EURO RACING. Obj We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates. L9 Sebulba's Podracer (V). L39 sheet Alibi (V). L40 Out Of Commission (V). See notes/batch8_notes.py.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates]]
* '''Username:''' DDM
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
